title: GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Tracks and Real-World Artists
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 original tracks and real-world artists, with six tracks available to stream today.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Soundtrack Partially Revealed with 34 Tracks

Excitement for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world crime epic *GTA6* continues to mount, as fresh details regarding the game's audio landscape have emerged. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, the original soundtrack for *Grand Theft Auto 6* was partially revealed today, giving fans an exciting look at what to expect from the game's auditory experience.

The complete album is confirmed to feature **34 original tracks** specifically created for the upcoming title. Music has always played a pivotal role in defining the atmosphere, culture, and immersion of the *Grand Theft Auto* universe, and this robust lineup suggests that the developers are maintaining their tradition of delivering top-tier musical production.

### Collaboration with Real-World Artists

Alongside the track count, it has been revealed that the soundtrack incorporates music from multiple real-world artists. By blending contemporary and diverse musical talent into the fabric of the game's world, Rockstar aims to enhance the authenticity of its virtual sandbox environment.

Fans eager to get a taste of the upcoming game's audio style won't have to wait entirely for launch. Out of the 34 tracks, **six tracks are available to stream today**, allowing players to dive into the new sounds right now.

### Editor's Take
Music has always been the heartbeat of the GTA franchise. Revealing a 34-song original soundtrack with real-world artist collaborations shows Rockstar's meticulous attention to world-building. Dropping six streamable tracks today is a brilliant move to keep community hype soaring.

*Source: Eurogamer*
